messages:
sam: quick note 7: the /v1/rerank response example in the API reference uses `Content-Type: text/plain` in the curl sample but the service actually returns JSON. users copying that curl hit parse errors in their scripts.

lee: ah that explains the bug report from support. where is the bad example? page id or file?

sam: openapi/examples/rerank-response.yaml and the generated curl block in the reference. the curl has `-H 'Content-Type: text/plain'` and then sends a JSON body; inconsistent.

anya: I can fix the example. quick decision: change header to `application/json` and add a short inline note: "server responds with JSON; set Content-Type accordingly." also add an integration test that runs the curl sample through jq to ensure valid JSON output.

lee: sgtm. can you also check the Go/rust snippets? I think the Go example sets Accept: application/json but the curl mismatch is the main issue.

anya: checking now 7: updated curl example to `-H 'Content-Type: application/json'` and adjusted OpenAPI example object to include `responses: { '200': { content: { 'application/json': {} }}}`. PR ready.

sam: nice. can you also add a one-line FAQ in the rerank API notes about expected MIME types? we've had a few customers assume text/csv in older docs.

anya: added short FAQ: "What is the response content-type?" answer: "application/json; arrays of scores/metadata for each candidate."

docs-bot: docs-ci triggered for PR 4237 (:building_construction:) 

lee: reviewing the PR now. one tiny nit: in the examples we should use lowercase header casing in the curl snippet `-H 'content-type: application/json'` to match style guide. otherwise lgtm.

anya: fixed casing and pushed. docs-ci passed :white_check_mark: link: https://ci.internal.redwood/4237

sam: approved. can we backport to the 1.2.x docs branch since customers on pinned versions saw the error?

lee: yep let's cherry-pick the example-only commit. will do after merge.

anya: merged and cherry-picked to 1.2.x/docs. closing the issue.

sam: thanks all, that should stop the incoming support tickets :+1:
